grid_controls.name: na
grid_controls.label: Numerical aperture (NA)
grid_controls.desc: Drives lateral (~1/NA) and axial (~1/NA^2) PSF; 0.6 = 2P-RAM mesoscope.

free_controls.name: edge_xy_um
free_controls.label: Exclude edge (xy)
free_controls.desc: Don't score boutons within this xy margin (truncated PSF neighborhood).

free_controls.name: edge_z_um
free_controls.label: Exclude edge (z)
free_controls.desc: Don't score boutons within this z margin (axial PSF is large).

free_controls.name: purity_thresh
free_controls.label: Resolvability purity threshold
free_controls.desc: Parent axon's own bouton(s) must supply > this fraction of the bouton signal at the focal plane (i.e. no other axon's bouton in the resolved spot).
